command: set -e; BASE=http://192.168.0.16; sleep 5; ST="$(curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Script.GetStatus?id=1")"; SW="$(curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/rpc/Switch.GetStatus?id=0")"; DG="$(curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$BASE/script/1/diag")"; python3 -c 'import json,sys; st=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); sw=json.loads(sys.argv[2]); dg=json.loads(sys.argv[3]); assert st.get("running") is True,st; assert sw.get("output") is False,sw; assert isinstance(dg,dict) and dg,dg' "$ST" "$SW" "$DG"; echo POST_WIPE_SHELLY_RECHECK=pass; echo FINAL_RELAY=false
